item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #MINPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #MINPRSD
Issued at 06:00 PM 16 August 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #AgusanDelSur(Bunawan, LaPaz, Loreto), #DavaoDelNorte(Kapalong, Talaingod, CityOfTagum, SanIsidro, Asuncion), #DavaoDeOro(Monkayo, Maco, Mabini, Pantukan, Montevista), #Bukidnon(Cabanglasan, CityOfMalaybalay), #MisamisOccidental(OroquietaCity, LopezJaena, Calamba, Plaridel, Baliangao, SapangDalaga, Concepcion), #ZamboangaDelNorte(Sibutad, Rizal, DapitanCity, LeonB.Postigo, Salug, Godod, Liloy, Tampilisan, Sibuco, Sirawai, Siocon, Labason, Gutalac, Baliguian, Kalawit), #ZamboangaSibugay(Kabasalan, Naga, Ipil, RosellerLim, Titay, Tungawan), #ZamboangaCity and #MisamisOriental(CagayanDeOroCity) within the next 1-2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #AgusanDelSur(Trento, Veruela, SantaJosefa), #DavaoDeOro(Laak) and #ZamboangaDelNorte(LaLibertad) which may persist within 1-2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
